cards.questionText:
To: All Staff, Fairview Convention Center

From: Helga Matzner

Subject: Upcoming Conference

Date: October 12

We’re only three days away from the start of the annual National Geologists’ Conference that’s set to take place from October 15 to 17. We need to make sure everything is prepared since the attendees are going to begin arriving to check out the premises tomorrow. Please remember that most of the attendees will be staying at the Emporium Hotel or the Marconi Hotel. Since the Marconi Hotel is right across the street from the convention center, those individuals can get here with no problem. But we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus to the Emporium Hotel every 30 minutes from 8 A.M. to 10 P.M. on all three days of the conference. It takes roughly 25 minutes to get here from the hotel, so we’ll have a couple of buses running nonstop. Those of you who are responsible for the electronics need to double-check everything to make sure we don’t have any glitches. And we need to confirm with the caterers that the snacks, sandwiches, and drinks are going to arrive exactly when they need to be here. Let’s do our best to make this a successful conference.

_________________________________________________

Fairview Convention Center

Survey Card

Thank you for attending an event at the Fairview Convention Center. In order to improve the quality of the service we provide, please take a few moments to fill out this card and to answer the questions in full.

Name: Rupert Helmond

Event: National Geologists’ Conference

Date(s) Attended: October 15-17

E-mail: rupert@gemstones.org

Telephone Number: (604) 455-5847

How did you feel about the following:

Overall Quality of the Conference

Comments: This was the first event I ever attended at your convention center. However, I have attended numerous conferences at other similar centers. Your staff members compare very favorably to those individuals working at those places. Anytime I had a problem, a staff member was able to assist me almost immediately. The shuttle bus was impressive as well. I took it several times, and not once was it late. There were a couple of problems with the electronics malfunctioning during speeches though. For example, a microphone stopped working for around ten minutes during one individual's speech. But the conference went quite well overall.

childQuestions.questionText: Why did Ms. Matzner write the memo?
options: (A) To review how well a conference went
(B) To discuss some final preparations
(C) To provide an overview of the day’s events
(D) To mention some changes in plans
childQuestions.transcript: Reading through the passage, we can see that the passage discusses preparations for the upcoming conference (through some information such as "we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus to the Emporium Hotel every 30 minutes from 8 A.M. to 10 P.M. on all three days of the conference. It takes roughly 25 minutes to get here from the hotel, so we’ll have a couple of buses running nonstop. Those of you who are responsible for the electronics need to double-check everything to make sure we don’t have any glitches, ...) => Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Đọc đoạn văn, chúng ta có thể thấy đoạn văn thảo luận về việc chuẩn bị cho hội nghị sắp tới (thông qua một số thông tin như "we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus to the Emporium Hotel every 30 minutes from 8 A.M. to 10 P.M. on all three days of the conference. It takes roughly 25 minutes to get here from the hotel, so we’ll have a couple of buses running nonstop. Those of you who are responsible for the electronics need to double-check everything to make sure we don’t have any glitches"

=> Chọn B

childQuestions.questionText: According to the memo, what is true about the attendees at the conference?
options: (A) Most of them have never visited Fairview before.
(B) They are all staying at the Marconi Hotel.
(C) A few of them have not registered yet.
(D) Some of them will arrive on October 13.
correctOptions: (D) Some of them will arrive on October 13.
childQuestions.transcript: There is information "We need to make sure everything is prepared since the attendees are going to begin arriving to check out the premises tomorrow." Meanwhile, we can see the date when the memo is written is October 12. "Tomorrow" here is the day after October 12 which is October 13. => D is correct.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin "We need to make sure everything is prepared since the attendees are going to begin arriving to check out the premises tomorrow."

Chúng ta có thể thấy ngày mà bản thông báo được viết là ngày 12 tháng 10 (October 12). "Ngày mai" ở đây là ngày sau ngày 12 tháng 10 tức là ngày 13 tháng 10 (October 13).

childQuestions.questionText: What does the memo NOT mention about the conference?
options: (A) People interested in geology will be attending it.
(B) The shuttle bus for passengers will be free of charge.
(C) It is going to last for three days.
(D) Attendees must pay for the catered food.
correctOptions: (D) Attendees must pay for the catered food.
childQuestions.transcript:
"National Geologists’ Conference" => Eliminate A 

"we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus" => Eliminate B

"We’re only three days away from the start of the annual National Geologists’ Conference that’s set to take place from October 15 to 17." => Eliminate C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Bản thông báo KHÔNG đề cập đến điều gì về hội nghị?

(A) Những người quan tâm đến địa chất sẽ tham dự.

(B) Xe buýt đưa đón hành khách sẽ miễn phí.

(C) Nó sẽ kéo dài trong ba ngày.

(D) Người tham dự phải trả tiền cho bữa ăn được phục vụ.

Trong bài có đề cập đến

+ "National Geologists’ Conference" 

=> Loại A 

+ "we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus" nghĩa là "chúng tôi sẽ chạy xe buýt đưa đón miễn phí"

=> Loại B

+ "We’re only three days away from the start of the annual National Geologists’ Conference that’s set to take place from October 15 to 17." - nghĩa là "Chúng ta chỉ còn ba ngày nữa là bắt đầu Hội nghị các nhà địa chất quốc gia hàng năm dự kiến ​​diễn ra từ ngày 15 đến ngày 17 tháng 10."

=> Loại C 

=> Chọn đáp án D

childQuestions.questionText: How does Mr. Helmond feel about the staff at the Fairview Convention Center?
options: (A) They were not very knowledgeable.
(B) They provided him with lots of help.
(C) They acted rudely to attendees at times.
(D) They made the conference a success.
correctOptions: (B) They provided him with lots of help.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "Anytime I had a problem, a staff member was able to assist me almost immediately."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong bài có đề cập: "Bất cứ khi nào tôi gặp vấn đề, nhân viên đều có thể hỗ trợ tôi gần như ngay lập tức."

=> chọn B

options: (A) He stayed at the Emporium Hotel.
(B) He is a professor of geology.
(C) He is a resident of Fairview.
(D) He has an interest in electronics.
correctOptions: (A) He stayed at the Emporium Hotel.
childQuestions.transcript: In the second passage, Mr. Helmond says that " The shuttle bus was impressive as well." Meanwhile, in the first passage, there is information "But we’ll be running a complimentary shuttle bus to the Emporium Hotel"  => It can be inferred that Mr. Helmond stayed at the Emporium Hotel. => A is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong đoạn văn thứ hai, ông Helmond nói rằng "Xe buýt đưa đón cũng rất ấn tượng." Trong khi đó, ở đoạn đầu tiên có thông tin “Nhưng chúng tôi sẽ chạy xe buýt đưa đón miễn phí đến khách sạn Emporium” => Có thể suy ra rằng ông Helmond đã ở tại khách sạn Emporium.

=> A đúng

cards.questionText:
Morrell Bank Seeks New Employee

Morrell Bank, one of the oldest banks in the state of Texas, is looking for a qualified individual to manage its branch on Gila Street in Waco.

Responsibilities: The manager will be responsible for the daily operations of the bank. He or she will be in charge of looking after the financial stability of the bank and will give final approval for all loan applications. The manager will also make sure the employees at the branch are providing quality service and are sufficiently representing the values of Morrell Bank.

Qualifications: The manager should have the following qualifications:

• Have a minimum of five years of experience in a supervisory position at a bank

• Be outgoing and get along well with others

• Have a thorough knowledge of the banking industry, finance, and economics

• Be a good organizer

How to Apply: Qualified applicants should send a resume, a cover letter, and the names of and contact information for three professional references to Urania Desmond, HR Director, Morrell Bank, 46 Alamo Drive, Dallas, TX. Ms. Desmond may be contacted with any questions at udesmond@morrellbank.com.

Morrell Bank is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual's age, gender, or ethnicity.

_________________________________________________

Urania Desmond

HR Director

Morrell Bank

46 Alamo Drive

Dallas, Texas

August 2

Harry Astley

302 Rio Grande Boulevard

Waco, TX

Dear Mr. Astley,

Thank you for submitting your application for branch manager at the Morrell Bank in Waco. In normal situations, I would not be contacting you since you have only managed Freedom Bank for the past couple of years. However, I am aware of how well your bank is doing, so I took the liberty of speaking with two of the references you provided. Both of them spoke about you in glowing terms. They stressed that you not only possess a keen financial mind but also get along with people and that your employees all like you.

You sound like the kind of individual who would excel at Morrell Bank. As such, I would like to invite you to interview for the position, while the job is in Waco, the first interview will be held at our headquarters in Dallas. We have scheduled you for an interview on Saturday, August 16, at 10 A.M. If you can interview then, a first-class round-trip plane ticket from Waco to Dallas will be reserved for you, and we will also book you a room at the Emerson Hotel. Please note that should you do well, we will conduct a second interview at the Waco branch where you would be working. That interview would take place on August 30.

Please call me at (382) 634-6468 to confirm that you will be interviewing with us.

Sincerely,

Urania Desmond

HR Director

Morrell Bank

childQuestions.questionText: What is the bank manager expected to do?
options: (A) Interview individuals requesting loans
(B) Organize training sessions for employees
(C) Oversee all matters related to personnel
(D) Confirm that employees are doing their duties
correctOptions: (D) Confirm that employees are doing their duties
childQuestions.transcript: Based on information "The manager will also make sure the employees at the branch are providing quality service and are sufficiently representing the values of Morrell Bank."  => Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi: Dựa trên thông tin "Người quản lý cũng sẽ đảm bảo rằng các nhân viên tại chi nhánh đang cung cấp dịch vụ có chất lượng và đại diện đầy đủ cho các giá trị của Ngân hàng Morrell." => Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: How can people apply for the position?
options: (A) By filling out an application on a web page
(B) By submitting their applications by e-mail
(C) By sending their applications in the mail
(D) By turning in their applications in person
correctOptions: (C) By sending their applications in the mail
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "Qualified applicants should send a resume, a cover letter, and the names of and contact information for three professional references to Urania Desmond, HR Director, Morrell Bank, 46 Alamo Drive, Dallas, TX."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong bài có đề cập: "Qualified applicants should send a resume, a cover letter, and the names of and contact information for three professional references to Urania Desmond, HR Director, Morrell Bank, 46 Alamo Drive, Dallas, TX." 

Tạm dịch: "Những ứng viên đủ điều kiện nên gửi sơ yếu lý lịch, thư xin việc, tên và thông tin liên hệ của ba tài liệu tham khảo chuyên môn tới Urania Desmond, Giám đốc Nhân sự, Ngân hàng Morrell, 46 Alamo Drive, Dallas, TX."

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: According to Ms. Desmond, why is Mr. Astley NOT qualified for the position?
options: (A) He has poor organizational skills.
(B) He does not have a degree in economics.
(C) He has fewer than five years of experience.
(D) He has never worked at a bank before.
correctOptions: (C) He has fewer than five years of experience.
childQuestions.transcript: The position requires "five years of experience in a supervisory position at a bank". Meanwhile, Mr. Astley has only two years of experience (I would not be contacting you since you have only managed Freedom Bank for the past couple of years.) => C is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Vị trí này yêu cầu "năm năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí giám sát tại một ngân hàng". Trong khi đó, ông Astley chỉ có hai năm kinh nghiệm (Tôi sẽ không liên lạc với bạn vì bạn chỉ mới quản lý Freedom Bank trong vài năm qua.)

=> C đúng

childQuestions.questionText: In the letter, the word “keen” in paragraph 1, line 5 is closest in meaning to:
options: (A) sharp
(B) curious
(C) adequate
(D) precise
childQuestions.transcript:
(A) sharp: clear and definite

(B) curious: having a strong desire to know about something

(C) adequate: enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need

(D) precise: clear and accurate

Based on the meaning => Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong thư, từ “keen” ở đoạn 1, dòng 5 gần nghĩa nhất với:

(A) sắc nét

(B) tò mò

(C) đầy đủ

(D) chính xác

Trong bài đề cập đến: "They stressed that you not only possess a keen financial mind." nghĩa là "Họ nhấn mạnh rằng bạn không chỉ sở hữu đầu óc tài chính nhạy bén."

=> tương đương với "sharp mind"

=> chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: What is Mr. Astley asked to do?
options: (A) Reserve a plane ticket to Dallas
(B) Confirm he can interview on August 16
(C) Send an e-mail to Ms. Desmond
(D) Visit Waco for an interview on August 30
correctOptions: (B) Confirm he can interview on August 16
childQuestions.transcript: Based on information "We have scheduled you for an interview on Saturday, August 16, at 10 A.M." , "Please call me at (382) 634-6468 to confirm that you will be interviewing with us."  => Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong bài có đề cập là: "We have scheduled you for an interview on Saturday, August 16, at 10 A.M." , "Please call me at (382) 634-6468 to confirm that you will be interviewing with us."

Tạm dịch: "Chúng tôi đã lên lịch cho bạn một cuộc phỏng vấn vào thứ Bảy, ngày 16 tháng 8, lúc 10 giờ sáng." , "Xin vui lòng gọi cho tôi theo số (382) 634-6468 để xác nhận rằng bạn sẽ phỏng vấn với chúng tôi."

=> B đúng
